candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care, Appendix A, printed p.21 / PDF p.25 — Collaboration with Multidisciplinary Team and Continuity of Care
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — multidisciplinary discharge planning and continuity of care
candidate.educational_objective: Support safe discharge and continuity of care by identifying and collaborating with the multidisciplinary team members needed to address the client's post-discharge needs and by communicating significant information across disciplines.

options.A: Coordinate with the appropriate multidisciplinary team members and communicate the client's needs across disciplines
options.B: Complete the discharge plan independently without input from other disciplines
options.C: Limit planning to the client's current room assignment and inpatient routine
options.D: Delay communication with other disciplines until after the client has left the hospital

candidate.rationale: The 2026 NCSBN Test Plan places multidisciplinary collaboration and continuity of care within Management of Care. It directs nurses to identify and collaborate with multidisciplinary team members, report significant information to other disciplines, review the plan of care for continuity across disciplines, and safely discharge clients. Therefore A is correct. B, C, and D undermine coordinated discharge planning and continuity of care.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Safe discharge and continuity of care require collaboration and communication with appropriate multidisciplinary team members rather than isolated planning by one discipline.
candidate.source_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care, printed p.21 / PDF p.25: 'Collaboration with Multidisciplinary Team' and 'Continuity of Care' — identify/collaborate with multidisciplinary team members, report significant information to other disciplines, review plan of care for continuity, and perform procedures necessary to safely discharge a client
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: A hospitalized client has medication, mobility, and social-support needs that must be addressed before discharge. Which action by the nurse best supports discharge planning and continuity of care?
